messages:
incidentbot: :rotating_light: Autopager fired: prometheus.scrape_failures >= 5 (kafka-exporter-prod) — page routed to #eng-sre and oncall.

alex: acked. I'm on it, grabbing logs and graph.

ria: i'm on pagerduty, pulling the alert details now. saw scrape errors ~3m ago.

sam: saw increased log backlog on log-ingest-prod earlier, could be related. kafka-exporter tends to fall over if broker lag spikes.

alex: quick check: `kubectl -n prod get pods -l app=kafka-exporter` shows 2/3 pods restarting. getting OOM in one.

sam: paste of last lines from exporter stderr: 
```
2026-03-15T08:21:12Z level=error msg="scrape failed" err="timeout reading metrics"
2026-03-15T08:21:13Z level=warn msg="high GC pause"
2026-03-15T08:21:14Z level=error msg="out of memory: alloc failed"
```

ria: thanks. looks like exporter pod OOM -> Prom scrape failures -> autopage. Any recent config changes to exporter resource limits?

alex: not in prod. last deploy was 3d ago. suspect correlated with kafka partition rebalance at 08:18 UTC (autoscaler shuffled brokers).

ops-l2: if broker rebalance caused higher CPU for exporter (more metrics/time series), could push memory. We should: 1) scale exporter replicas 2) temporarily increase scrape timeout/interval for kafka-exporter job 3) restart failing pod with higher memory.

alex: executing step 1: `kubectl -n prod scale deploy kafka-exporter --replicas=5` — scaled.

sam: step 2, changing prometheus scrape config for job `kafka-exporter` to `scrape_interval: 30s` -> `60s` and `timeout: 10s` -> `20s` in staging-first then prod. will push via configmap.

ria: I'm paging L2 to standby for potential broader impact. @ops-l2, can you take lead if this becomes customer-impactful?

ops-l2: on it. also checking log-ingest queue depth: `kafka-consumer-lag` shows backlog spike ~20k messages in the metrics-topic.

alex: restarting the OOMing pod now with `kubectl -n prod delete pod kafka-exporter-7f6b9` so it restarts with the new resources.

sam: PR to update prometheus config pushed and applied in staging. will roll to prod in 2m.

ria: customer ops ping: noticed dashboards for some enterprise customers show missing broker metrics since 08:19. Not yet widespread but could affect SLA if not resolved in 30m. tagging customers-CS.

alex: restarted pod is now Running. memory usage post-restart showing higher baseline but stable for ~30s.

incidentbot: Pagerduty note: PD incident created PD-3456, escalation policy: oncall -> ops-l2 -> engineering-manager.

ops-l2: increasing exporter mem limit from 512Mi -> 1Gi on the restarted pod - patch applied. Observing reduced OOMs.

sam: prod prometheus config updated: kafka-exporter job now `scrape_interval: 60s` and `timeout: 20s`. pushing to reload Prometheus.

ria: Prometheus reload acknowledged. initial scrape after reload succeeded for 2 of 5 replicas.

alex: backlog in metrics-topic still draining but consumer throughput doubled after we increased exporter replicas. lag down from 20k -> 6k in 4m.

ops-l2: mitigation looks effective. continuing to monitor for 30m. tagging incident for follow-up postmortem.

ria: customer ops update sent: limited impact to dashboards for ~20 minutes, no alerting downstream other than internal autopages. CS will follow up with impacted customers.

sam: note: log-ingest pipeline also showed transient Throttling errors to S3 earlier; that's likely from the burst during rebalance — we'll correlate in postmortem.

alex: PD-3456 acknowledged by ops-l2. setting PD incident to "investigating".

incidentbot: autopager condition cleared: prometheus.scrape_failures < 2 for kafka-exporter. Autopager auto-resolved.

ria: marking thread for handoff: @ops-l2 you own until full recovery and postmortem. Please include root cause + follow-ups (limit exporter memory growth, more graceful handling during broker rebalance, tune scrape configs).

ops-l2: confirming handoff. creating follow-up ticket: INF-7890 (investigate exporter memory+rebalance), will schedule 2-hour postmortem sync and include runbook updates.

alex: quick runbook note: when kafka partition rebalance is expected, temporarily increase exporter replicas or quiesce scrapes for 5-10m. I'll add a checklist to the runbook.

ria: thanks all. closing slack thread once postmortem ticket is created. :white_check_mark:

sam: FYI — logs saved to /var/log/sre/incidents/2026-03-15-kafka-exporter-oom.log and uploaded to incident artifacts.

ops-l2: last check — metrics lag steady at ~500 and counting down. won't escalate further.

alex: good job.
